description: Conduct and document risk assessment for all work activities and update after significant changes
Implement preventive and protective measures prioritising collective over individual protection
Provide documented safety and health information and training to all workers
Appoint safety delegate (delegado de segurança) for workplaces with 10 or more workers
Organise occupational health services either internally or through external provider
Maintain Records of Processing Activities (ROPA) documenting all personal data processing
Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) before high-risk processing operations
Respond to data subject access requests within 30 days extendable to 90 with notice
Notify supervisory authority of data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware
Appoint Data Protection Officer where processing involves large-scale sensitive data or public authority
Ensure health surveillance for workers exposed to specific occupational risks (noise vibration chemicals)
Designate competent worker(s) with sufficient resources and time for protection and prevention activities
Establish coordination procedures for safety when multiple employers work at same location
Document Gefährdungsbeurteilung (risk assessment) and review after incidents or changes
Provide Unterweisung (safety instruction) before first job start and annually thereafter
Appoint Datenschutzbeauftragter (DPO) for public bodies and organisations processing at large scale
Obtain Bundes-Immissionsschutz permit before operating regulated installation
Apply best available techniques (BAT) to minimise emissions and environmental impact
Prepare written health and safety policy for organisations with 5 or more employees
Conduct suitable and sufficient risk assessment and record significant findings
Maintain accident records and report specified injuries and dangerous occurrences under RIDDOR
Appoint UK DPO where required by UK GDPR and register with ICO
Notify ICO of data breaches within 72 hours where feasible under UK GDPR requirements
Document lawful basis for each category of personal data processing activity
Establish and publish process enabling data subjects to exercise their 9 LGPD rights
Respond to data subject requests within 15 days of receipt
Implement Occupational Risk Management Program (PGR) identifying inventorying and controlling risks
Review and update PGR documentation at minimum every 2 years or after occupational accident
Provide appropriate INMETRO-certified PPE free of charge to workers requiring it
Train workers on correct PPE use maintenance and limitations before first use
Maintain individual PPE distribution records (ficha de EPI) for each worker
Maintain workplace free from recognized serious hazards under the general duty clause
Report work-related fatalities to OSHA within 8 hours of occurrence
Report work-related in-patient hospitalisation amputation or eye loss within 24 hours
Maintain OSHA 300 injury and illness log and post 300A summary annually
Provide privacy notice to California residents at or before collection of personal information
Process and respond to consumer deletion requests within 45 calendar days
Implement cybersecurity risk management measures proportional to size and risk exposure
Submit early warning to CSIRT or authority within 24 hours of significant incident
Submit full incident notification within 72 hours and final report within one month
Publish annual sustainability report using ESRS standards as part of management report
Monitor ambient air quality and report against NAAQS standards for criteria pollutants
Apply MACT standards for listed hazardous air pollutants from major stationary sources
